{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check: number of patients after deduplication
print("Number of patients after deduplication:", len(df_dedup))
print("Number of original rows:", len(df))
print("Number of retested patients:", len(df) - len(df_dedup))

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL
# Only apply to assay_batch == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 3: Confirm that biomarker_final is now in ng/mL and has no invalid values
print("After correction, biomarker_final range:", df_dedup['biomarker_final'].describe())
print("Any -999 in biomarker_final?", (df_dedup['biomarker_final'] == -999).any())

# Step 4: Compute mean biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL):", mean_biomarker_final)"}
